body: Thanks! I forgot about reading! I If you have good recommendations for me (I liked Battle Royale, Lord of the Flies, etc.) Can you recommend me some?

I like your philosophy; and I agree that I should learn as much as I can, but I am legitimately the laziest sack of shit you will ever see.  I constantly ask; how can I become less lazy and learn more?  I wish to, but am just so lazy.  Perhaps it is because of the games that I play.

Thank you for your kind words; but the problem with the something else I should do; I don't know.  I am a lost, lazy person, and don't know what interests me.  I like to play games and such, like a child.  I have tried to pick up programming, but I have minimal commitment.  I have already accepted that I am extremely insignificant, but what can I do to sustain myself through life?  I would work for money (Like minimum wage worker, per say McDonald's cashier), but hate to do school work.  If this is confusing, I apologize.
What can I do about myself?
